args:
Animate this single character into a simple west / left-facing in-place walk cycle for a 2D game sprite.

Use the input image as a strict first-frame identity, palette, scale, and sprite-style reference.
Preserve the exact costume colors, outline weight, facial proportions, hair shape, and every small outfit and equipment detail.
Do not redesign, repaint, recolor, simplify, smooth, or invent character details.

The character must face west / left-facing for the entire clip.
Do not turn toward any other direction.
Do not pivot, rotate, or show a quarter-turn view.
Maintain a pure side-profile silhouette facing screen-left in every frame.
Only the side of the head and side of the torso should be visible; do not reveal both eyes, the full front of the chest, or both shoulders.
Move arms and legs in a side-view locomotion plane, forward and backward across the screen, not toward the viewer.
Screen-space directions: the character faces profile facing screen-left, so the character's forward is the LEFT edge of the frame and backward is the RIGHT edge of the frame. Any step, lunge, strike, kick, or attack that goes forward must travel toward the LEFT edge of the frame; recoil, stagger, or knockback must travel toward the RIGHT edge of the frame. Resolve every direction against the screen frame, never the character's own left or right.

Keep the camera fixed and centered and the framing unchanged.
Keep the full-body character large in the frame at the same apparent scale as the input image.
Keep the plain background as one uninterrupted flat exact chroma green #00FF00 plate.
No shadow of any kind under or behind the character: no cast, contact, or ground shadow, blob, base ellipse, reflection, footprint, floor line, ground line, or platform edge.
Do not turn the background into a floor, room, horizon, scene, or perspective grid.
No lighting gradients, texture, matte-color spill, background motion, motion blur, smear frames, cinematic lighting, color grading, or ground-contact effects.

Make the motion low-fidelity, readable, and suited to a game sprite reference.
Use a looping in-place walk cycle with readable game-animation key poses, controlled vertical bobbing, and light clothing/equipment sway.
Use clear alternating left/right stride poses: left foot forward while right foot back, then right foot forward while left foot back. Arms counter-swing opposite the legs. Show foot-down timing through limb pose only. Do not move both arms forward together. Do not move both feet together. Do not make a shuffle, wiggle, bounce-only idle, marching-in-place twitch, or synchronized arm-and-foot sway.
Preserve the sprite-like pixelated look and the exact character identity in every frame.
Preserve any existing held or worn equipment from the reference as attached parts of the character.
If the reference includes a held item, keep it gripped by the same hand in every frame; it must not float, detach, duplicate, or swing as an attack.

One character only.
Flat chroma background only.
No scene.
No new props.
No effects.
No attack animation.
No weapon or held-item swing.
No palette drift.
No costume drift.
No boot simplification.

Additional user action note:
- Bo performs a slow relaxed in-place walk toward screen-left with short deliberate steps. One foot remains touching the fixed baseline at all times: planted contact, passing pose, opposite planted contact. No airborne phase, no running, no leaping, no sprint lean. Exactly two complete strides and exact return to the starting pose for a seamless loop. Preserve the input drawing exactly: same black shaggy oval, same eyes, same white near-side arm curved across the front ending in one round dot, never replace it with a black projecting arm. Bindle stays screen-right on the same far anatomical arm behind fur; pole and bundle keep their exact design. Locked camera, fixed scale, restrained body bob, no shadow, no ground line, flat green canvas, one character.

Apply the note to the action only; keep identity, direction, camera, background, and output format unchanged.
